title: Quarterly Roadmap Spine: Aligning OKRs to Release Trains and Launch Windows
creator: Elena Park
description: Purpose: create a repeatable ‘roadmap spine’ artifact and process that maps quarterly OKRs and initiatives to concrete release trains, launch windows, and outcomes for runtime/console/API. This ticket scopes the deliverables needed for Q2 planning: a template artifact (roadmap spine), owner roster and rotation rules, guardrails for capacity and dependency windows, and a lightweight dashboard to track initiative-to-release progress. The intent is to reduce last-minute scope churn, clarify escalation lanes, and create traceability from OKR -> initiative -> release window -> SLO/metrics owners.
acceptance_criteria:
1) A documented roadmap-spine template that links OKRs to prioritized initiatives and assigned release trains.
2) Owner roster and rotation policy published and signed off by Eng, Design, and Security.
3) Launch-window guardrails (capacity commitments, blackout windows, rollback triggers) defined and adopted for Q2.
4) A minimal tracking dashboard (sheet or lightweight dashboard) that shows initiative status, release-train assignment, key dependencies, and OKR metric mapping.
5) Two pilot initiatives mapped through the spine and validated during a planning rehearsal.
notes: Key trade-offs: we will avoid building a heavy new tool this quarter; the spine must be an opinionated human-readable artifact that integrates with Linear labels and existing dashboards. The template balances granularity (per-feature owners and SLOs) with maintainability (weekly cadence updates only). Dependencies on Dedicated capacity APIs and Console rollout telemetry are expected; if those are blocked we will run a manual bake-in stage. Governance: PMs own OKR-to-initiative mapping; Release Train Leads own window assignments and cutover criteria; Eng leads own capacity commitments.
